description: TPO 1 of 1985. Construction works within the Root Protection Areas (RPAs) of 2 London Plane trees on the neighbouring properties (109A/107 Tottenham road) adjoining the rear of 84 Buckingham road. Works include a single 70mm diameter root tapering to 15mm/40mm diameter root at shallow level below ground to be removed, all other roots to be retained, the void to be backfilled according to a root-friendly method; T1 and T2 crown clean in sectors over the site; pruning to clear 4m above local ground level within the site, only to twig tips/minor branches with a maximum diameter of 50mm. Full details in Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS).
decision_conditions: <p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">CONDITION: This permission shall expire after a period of two years from the date of this decision.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON:&nbsp; In order that the Local Planning Authority can review any change in circumstances after this period and to avoid the accumulation of unimplemented permissions.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">CONDITION: The tree works hereby approved shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the description on this notice of approval by a suitable qualified tree surgeon and in accordance with BS3998:2010 ‘Recommendations for tree works’ (or any standard that reproduces or replaces this standard).&nbsp;</span></p><p><br></p><p dir="ltr" style="text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON:&nbsp; In the interests of visual amenity and good arboricultural practice, having regard to Policy LP51 in the Local Plan 2033 (adopted 2020).</span></p>

<p>CONDITION: The works hereby approved shall not be carried out unless in accordance with the approved Tree Protection Plan and Arboricultural Method Statement by John Cromer ref S1522-J1-R1. The measures set out in the Tree Protection Plan shall remain in place until the completion of the construction. Any permanent hard surfacing within RPAs of retained trees should be installed and maintained in line with the approved AMS using a ‘no-dig’ method as outlined within the report.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: To safeguard existing tree(s) in the interests of visual amenity, having regard to Policy LP51 in the Local Plan 2033 (adopted 2020) and pursuant to Section 197 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.</p><div><br></div>

<p>CONDITION: The demolition, construction and excavation affecting T1 and T2 must be supervised by the qualified arboriculturalist and strictly follow the methodology and programme for reporting, as well as a timetable for inspections included in the Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS) produced by John Cromer ref S1522-J1-R1.</p><p>Upon completion of the development, a report from the appointed arboriculturist must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, confirming that all tree protection measures and tree works were carried out in accordance with the approved plans accompanied by photographs taken at critical stages.</p><div><div>REASON: to ensure that works affecting trees are carried out in a professional and controlled manner, safeguarding their health and long-term viability. This is in accordance with good arboricultural practice and is supported by BS 5837:2012 and Policy LP51 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033.</div><div><br></div></div>
